lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine singular (form IV) perfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: وَأَكْدَىٰٓ is in the derivative form: أكْدَى
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ك/د/ي   k–d–y big boulder; obstacle; to deny assistance, to be mean, (of water or plants) to cease to give, to be sluggish. Of this root, أكْدىَ ʾakdā occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
أكْدَى ʾakdā [v. IV, intrans.] to hold back, to cease to act, to dry up

(53:34) وَأَعْطَى قَلِيلا وَأَكْدَى and he only gave a little and then he ceased.
